verdict.rationale: Zep documents first-party agent-framework integrations that name LangGraph, CrewAI, and the Vercel AI SDK, among others. These integrations persist conversation turns and retrieve Context Graph data, search, and context placement. LangChain itself is not named in the evidence, so the story is not completely covered, and the integration docs are only summarized at the overview level. missing for 10: explicit documented LangChain integration, per-framework integration depth/setup detail, independent or hands-on corroboration of the integrations working.

support.subject: As a developer, I can drop the memory layer into agent frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or the Vercel AI SDK via documented first-party integrations

citations.quote: Use Zep as agent memory with LangGraph, CrewAI, Google ADK, AutoGen, LiveKit, Strands, Vercel AI SDK, Eve, and other supported frameworks.
The integrations persist conversation turns and retrieve data from the user's Context Graph.
Zep integrations for agent frameworks support agent memory, Context Graph search, and context placement.
